messages:
alex_p: Quick async check — console observability roadmap: dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestones. Need owners + any blocking deps before EOW. Who's paired on dashboards and CI status?

mira_eng: I can take dashboards ownership for the initial rollout. Working on the metrics mapping doc today. Will own the PRs + dashboard templates.

jonas: I'll own tracing hooks + span standardization. Need a small schema review from infra (cc @sam_ops) — specifically the `trace.context.user_id` vs `trace.context.principal_id` field.

sam_ops: I can review the schema. Main blocker: the current logging agent image on staging is pinned to 1.2.0 which doesn't emit the new span tags. I filed infra task INF-783. ETA for image bump is tomorrow if no surprises.

lina_pm: Thanks — good to know. Mira, can you add the dashboard audiences (SRE, PLG, Product) to the templates? We want separate quick views for latency regressions vs cost.

mira_eng: yup — will add 3 tabs. Also pinging @jonas for one tracing-backed widget idea (p90 tokenization time per endpoint).

jonas: sounds good. Also note: for error-analysis views I need sample traces linked to Sentry events. Is Sentry sampling still at 1%?

sam_ops: Sentry sampling is at 5% on prod, 10% on staging. We should be able to tie traces to events if the agent is sending `event_id`. I'll follow up in INF-784.

alex_p: Action items so far: Mira -> dashboards + templates; Jonas -> tracing hooks + schema; Sam -> infra tasks INF-783/784. Lina -> finalize audiences & acceptance criteria. Can we get owners to post PR links / tickets in this thread when ready? :thumbsup:

mira_eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1423 — dashboard templates + readme. Needs review from @jonas and @lina_pm. Small note: I used `metrics.api.latency.p90` as the metric name.

jonas: reviewing now. Left one comment about tag normalization.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI pipeline for `console/dashboards` started (build 985). Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/build/985 :gear:

devsec_bot: devsec_bot: Quick scan — `console/pull/1423` flagged for missing hardening doc. Please add security checklist entry before merge.

mira_eng: noted — adding security checklist item now.

sam_ops: FYI — the image bump PR for logging agent is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/721. If that merges, staging will start emitting the new span tags.

lina_pm: timeline check — are we still on track for the retention milestone next sprint (keep 90d traces, 365d metric aggregates)? Any blockers to call out for leadership?

jonas: retention policy is ready but needs storage estimate from infra. Sam, can you attach a rough cost delta to INF-783/INF-785?

sam_ops: will calculate and add to INF-783 by EOD tomorrow. Early estimate: +12% S3/colocated storage for 365d trace indexes.

alex_p: Great. Final request: when you post PRs/tickets, please set the milestone field to `obs-roadmap-sprint-12` so we can query slices for the leadership report.

mira_eng: done on the dashboard PR.

jonas: added milestone to tracing PR draft.

sam_ops: INF-783 and INF-784 updated with milestone.

alex_p: Awesome — thanks team. If anyone hits a hard blocker, call it out here and we can reassign. Otherwise I'll compile a short status note for the sync on Friday. :memo: 

jonas: one more small ask — code review ping: @mira_eng I left a tiny refactor suggestion in PR #1423 to make the widget config more reusable. If you prefer I can push a follow-up branch.

mira_eng: I can take that — will push a follow-up with tests.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: `console/dashboards` build 985 succeeded and deployed to staging.

alex_p: Nice. Closing loop — I'll drop the compiled status into the roadmap doc and tag `@eng-leads` when ready. Thanks all.
